messages.author: 01c64ebe59d8f06b
messages.subject: Trouble with new R-version
parts:
Hi,
I updated my R-Version from 3.3.2 to 3.3.3. In 3.3.2 my shiny tool works fine, in 3.3.3 the ui does not work.

"Fehler in normalizeChoicesArgs(choices, choiceNames, choiceValues) : 
  Please specify a non-empty vector for `choices` (or, alternatively, for both `choiceNames` AND `choiceValues`)."

I dont even find the point of error. So its hard to write an Mini-Example. 
Anybody, who knows this failure?

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Trouble with new R-version
parts: This is a bug we introduced in Shiny 1.0.1 and will be patching soon. You can work around it by checking your radioButtons and checkboxGroupInput calls and replacing choices=NULL with choices=character(0). Sorry for the inconvenience.
